head: 75c914f5226685f331cbb2e56a9c4db7c52b24b9
question: how stored raw closes r(t) are converted to exact rationals for exact evaluation of f = r/a

protocol: v2.0.2 item 1: r_k = stored raw close, treated as exact (no rounding term)
v2.0.2 implementation note: snapshot stores closes as float64 parsed from the JSON numbers
v2.0.2/v2.0.3: d_k from the shortest round-trip decimal representation

exact_evaluation_rule.value_source: IEEE 754 binary64 values persisted in column close of bars_raw/<SYMBOL>.parquet (raw close r) and bars_all/<SYMBOL>.parquet (adjusted close a) of the immutable snapshot under evaluation
exact_evaluation_rule.raw_close_conversion: exact rational denoted by the shortest round-trip decimal representation of the persisted binary64 value
exact_evaluation_rule.adjusted_close_conversion: exact rational denoted by the shortest round-trip decimal representation of the persisted binary64 value (source made explicit; meaning unchanged)
exact_evaluation_rule.shortest_round_trip_definition: decimal string with the fewest significant digits that converts back to the identical binary64 under round-to-nearest-even; if several, the one numerically closest to the binary64 value
exact_evaluation_rule.raw_close_delta: none (raw closes exact, unchanged from v2.0.2/v2.0.3)
exact_evaluation_rule.adjusted_close_delta: unchanged: 1 / (2 * 10^max(d_k, 2)), d_k from the same shortest representation

rejected_sources.exact_binary64_value: parse artefact of decimal JSON; asymmetric with adjusted rule; reintroduces binary representation noise
rejected_sources.provider_json_text: not persisted; not reproducible from the snapshot alone

amendment_change_required: wording only (v2.0.4 §1, OQ10 status, implementation_impact.blocked_by); to be applied in DAY-18K after approval
